西班牙哈恩大學邀請姊妹校教師參與 2025語言測試設計及驗證課程，課程時間為2025年6月16日至27日，此活動將透過理論及實作工作坊，學習及分享相關知識及經驗。報名時間及活動資訊請參閱附件。

Universidad de Jaén in Spain would like to invite their partner university to participate in Course on Language Test Design and Validation , taking place from June 16–27, 2025.

This event will provide an opportunity to learn and share relevant knowledge and experiences through theoretical and practical workshops. Please refer to the attachment for registration details and event information.
